name: Choco-tan
source:
The heroine of the local anime, Choco-tan!

When the mystery prevents to discover all truths, the great Choco-tan and her assistant [url=https://vndb.org/c77647]Watson-kun[/url] are in charge of finding impossible answers and to stop the bad ones to send them in prison!

[spoiler]Character created by [url=https://vndb.org/c1530]Chiyoko[/url].[/spoiler]
